steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to OpenProject at http://127.0.0.1:8090/ as admin with password {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} (type it exactly as that text). Then open the project named 'Bench Project' and report the subjects of all work packages whose subject starts with 'Seed:' exactly as shown.

02-create: In the project 'Bench Project', create a new work package of type Task with subject '{{runid}} Bench Work Package' and a description that includes the text '{{runid}}'. Fill any required fields, save it, and report the work package's numeric ID as displayed (like #123), its subject, type, and description.

03-set: On work package #{{02-create.url.p4}} ('{{runid}} Bench Work Package') in Bench Project: 1) set the assignee to the user 'Bench Assignee' — type it in the assignee autocomplete and actually pick the option from the dropdown, not just type it; 2) set its status to 'In progress'; 3) set its finish date to 2026-12-31. These fields are edited in place (click to edit, they save automatically). Report the assignee, status, and finish date shown on the page after saving.

04-add: On work package #{{02-create.url.p4}} ('{{runid}} Bench Work Package'), add a comment whose text includes '{{runid}}' (e.g. 'Comment from {{runid}} run'). Submit it and report the comment text and its author as displayed on the page.
